presentation.label: RESONATOR
presentation.summary: Eight tuned partials for one to four voices: a chord of strings, tubes, bars, plates, drums or bells, or Aleksi Perälä's Colundi frequencies, excited by the track's own audio.
presentation.overview: The track's audio (left and right summed, filtered by TONE) excites eight resonant partials. VOIC shares them between one and four voices; TYPE gives every voice a body, from a pure mode through strings and tubes to bars, plates, drums and bells. PTCH sets the root and CHRD the other voices' notes. COLUN on makes PTCH a degree of the Colundi sequence (128 absolute frequencies from 10.8 Hz to 12 kHz) and snaps each voice to the nearest Colundi frequency; with COLUN off, SCALE snaps the notes into a key, so chords turn diatonic. Lock PTCH or CHRD on trigs to play the ring from the sequencer.
highlights: COLUN: PTCH picks one of the 128 Colundi frequencies (78 = 440 Hz), chords snap to Colundi
TYPE: PURE, STRNG, TUBE, BAR, PLATE, DRUM and BELL bodies; VOIC: one to four voices
CHRD: 14 chords and stacks, p-lockable per trig; SCALE keeps them in a key
Rings from 25 ms to 10 s and ends in digital silence; FX1 or FX2 on any track
usage: Put RESONATOR on FX1 of a drum or loop track. The defaults ring one string voice on A under each hit.
Hold FUNC and press FX1 for the setup page: VOIC adds chord voices, COLUN ON makes PTCH a Colundi degree.
Turn TYPE for the body (BAR and BELL for metal, DRUM for skins) and TONE to choose which partials ring.

controls.name: PTCH
controls.doc: Root. A MIDI note (69 = A at 440 Hz), snapped into SCALE's key when one is set. With COLUN on, a Colundi degree 0-127 (78 = 440 Hz, 79 = 441 Hz); the panel names it DEG.

controls.name: TYPE
controls.doc: Each voice's body, as its partials: PURE (one sine-like mode), STRNG (harmonics), TUBE (odd harmonics, a closed pipe), BAR (a struck beam), PLATE, DRUM (a membrane), BELL (hum, prime, tierce, quint ...).

controls.name: CHRD
controls.doc: The voices' notes above the root: OCT, 5TH, SUS2, SUS4, MAJ, MIN, MAJ7, MIN7, DOM7, DIM, AUG, ADD9, 5THS, 4THS. VOIC sets how many of the four notes sound; one voice plays the root only.

controls.name: DCAY
controls.doc: Ring time to -60 dB: 25 ms at 0, about 0.5 s at 64, 10 s at 127.

controls.name: GAIN
controls.doc: Ring level: 32 is 0 dB, 64 is +12 dB, 127 is +24 dB. Loud rings soft-clip at -3.5 dBFS.

controls.name: MIX
controls.doc: Dry/wet. 0 is exact passthrough and 127 only the ring; the dry falls as (1 - MIX/128)^2: -12 dB at 64, -26 dB at 100.

controls.name: COLUN
controls.doc: Setup page. ON: PTCH is a degree of the Colundi sequence and each voice snaps to the nearest of its 128 frequencies (a MAJ chord on 440 Hz rings 440, 528, 639 and 880 Hz). The voices' bodies keep their own overtones.

controls.name: VOIC
controls.doc: Setup page. How many voices share the eight partials: 1 voice has all 8, 2 voices 4 each, 3 voices 3, 3 and 2, 4 voices 2 each.

controls.name: TONE
controls.doc: Setup page. Filters what excites the partials: left of centre a low-pass from 20 kHz down to 150 Hz (only the low partials ring), centre flat, right a high-pass from 20 Hz up to 3 kHz (only the high ones ring).

controls.name: DAMP
controls.doc: Setup page. Shortens each voice's higher partials, each a step more than the one below; 0 rings them all for DCAY.

controls.name: SCALE
controls.doc: Setup page. OFF, or one of 12 keys x 10 scales (MAJ, MIN, DOR, PHR, LYD, MIX, HMI harmonic minor, MMI melodic minor, PMA and PMI pentatonic). The root and chord notes snap to the nearest note of the key; COLUN ignores it.

limitations: Two 15-minute RAM trials ran on the owner's unit with no crash, stall, freeze or skipped track (0.1.0 drafts of 23 Nov 2026); this eight-partial version has not run on a unit yet.
A pitch, chord or type change settles within eight DSP blocks (2.9 ms): one partial retunes per block.
Pitches assume 44.1 kHz. The input is summed to mono; the ring is spread across the stereo field.
A sustained tone on a mode's pitch with long DCAY and high GAIN soft-clips; lower GAIN or DCAY for a clean ring.
Until the module is listed, the panel shows TYPE, CHRD, COLUN, VOIC and SCALE as numbers (COLUN 0 off, 1 on; VOIC 0-3 is one to four voices).

license.declaration: Original code, tables, gate and documentation by Jannik Aßfalg, MIT. The Colundi sequence (128 frequencies) is Aleksi Perälä's, from colundi.net, used with the owner's permission recorded on 23 Nov 2026. No firmware, extracted routines or stock tables are included.

access.location: FUNC + FX1 or FUNC + FX2 SETUP on an audio track: the effect chooser. PTCH, TYPE, CHRD, DCAY, GAIN and MIX are on the FX main page; COLUN, VOIC, TONE, DAMP and SCALE on its SETUP page.
steps: Select an audio track that plays a sample.
Hold FUNC and press FX1 (or FX2) to open its SETUP. Turn LEVEL to RESONATOR and press YES.
Press FX1 (or FX2) for the main page: PTCH, TYPE, CHRD, DCAY, GAIN, MIX.
Hold FUNC and press FX1 (or FX2) again for the setup page: COLUN, VOIC, TONE, DAMP, SCALE.
